title: V.SY.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 62 (SD(SY)-40). V-SY (value system) is the subject; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-INTR (information interpretation) and DY-F (dynamic functionalism). From INFO-INTR: MOT-DY. From DY-F: RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: PART (participation). From PART: RT-OP (reality options).
